problem_type: Generation phase emitted after the operation it describes
symptom: Real App remains generating during main-process asset localization; finalizing appears only after save.
direct_cause: runCatalogGenerationTask reports finalizing after awaiting task IPC; buildProfileTaskResult localizes before resolving that IPC.
class_root: Localization ownership has no progress signal to the renderer before the actual write boundary.
affected_population: Synchronous and polled image/video/audio/model3d catalog outputs
entry_points: buildProfileTaskResult synchronous creation and polled result materialization
internal_only_reason: Internal Electron event and generation lifecycle; no third-party contract or new dependency.
invariants: The active node enters finalizing before its generated asset import starts; unrelated project/node events cannot change it.
generality_proof: All catalog media materialization calls localizeTaskAsset; the scoped runner listener reports via the existing shared narration callback.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Publish the real start before importing generated media.
Scope events by project and node, detach on every settlement.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Late result direct localization also uses localizeTaskAsset.

recurrence.reason: Any nontrivial download/write can expose the gap, across vendors and media.
same_class_scan: Read runCatalogGenerationTask and waitForCatalogTaskResult; both await IPC before reporting finalizing.

prevention.invariant: Emit localization start before generated asset import.
prevention.failure_mode: No matching active listener means no node mutation; failed imports still reject normally.
prevention.strategy: Signal from the real shared import boundary rather than guessing from renderer polling time.

legacy_paths.rationale: Move localization out of runtime and asset DTOs to the existing media bridge module; reexports preserve callers without duplicate implementations.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing Electron IPC and runtime; no package change.

migration: No persisted format changes; same phase vocabulary.
residual_risks: Initial generation timeline ghost is outside existing C1 scope; pending user clarification.

invariant_owner_layer.note: Media localization owns its start signal.
